task.title: Migrate simple actions and typography batch

batch.rollback: Use repository history and normal revert flow; no duplicate React implementation is retained in the package.

resolutions.finding: Canonical action elements adopt the React-owned Light-DOM native button marked with data-vf-action-control, preserving HTMLButtonElement refs, native attributes, public events, and documented classes while canonical VyrnForge owns shared action behavior.

The React typography API owns semantic native tags that the current canonical fixed Custom Element hosts cannot preserve. The renderer remains only under the active ADR-008 exception and its exit criteria.

rules: Do not preserve HTMLButtonElement compatibility through a Custom Element type cast.
Do not change documented React semantic tags merely to claim convergence.
Prefer a shared canonical capability over framework-specific DOM mutation.
Do not retain duplicate React implementation code after a canonical-backed cutover passes its parity and rollback checks.
